title: Use Modal.ButtonRow for modal action buttons instead of custom Stack/div
answers: How should I lay out buttons in a modal footer?
What component do I use for action buttons in a dialog?
Is there a standard way to arrange confirm/cancel buttons in a modal?
body:
Modal footer/action button rows should be built with `Modal.ButtonRow` (packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Modal/Modal.tsx), not a custom `<div>` wrapping a `<Stack>` with manual padding/gap styles.
Why: manual wrappers (e.g. the previous `buttonsContainer` css in ConfirmContent.tsx) can clip the button focus ring and duplicate spacing logic that `Modal.ButtonRow` already provides.
See packages/grafana-ui/src/components/ConfirmModal/ConfirmContent.tsx for the reference usage after migration.
applies: grafana-ui components that render a modal or dialog with action buttons
